verdict.rationale: Pipedrive documents a self-serve 14-day free trial with no credit card required, and a core sales-pipeline product. A community user describes it as having 'the ease of use of Trello', which supports a founder setting it up without an implementation partner. Nothing in the evidence shows getting real data in, such as a CSV/spreadsheet import or migration tool from another CRM, or any claim about time-to-value. The API is a developer building block and does not count toward that. missing for 10: documented data import/migration tooling, evidence of setup time under an hour, guided onboarding or pipeline setup flow, independent hands-on corroboration of a fast self-serve setup.
